problems.title: Job Set Operator is installed, but its JobSetOperator/cluster does not exist
problems.description: Modules check for the operator and for its operand: Job Set Operator does nothing until JobSetOperator/cluster exists, and the module keeps reporting it as not installed. It keeps the DataScienceCluster from being Ready.
evidence: DataScienceCluster default-dsc: TrainerReady=False (Error): dependency not met: JobSet Operator is not installed. Please install the JobSet Operator via OLM (OperatorHub) before deploying Trainer.
Catalog: package job-set in catalog redhat-operators (provider Red Hat, Inc.), default channel stable-v1.0, head jobset-operator.v1.0.1
problems.fix: Create JobSetOperator/cluster from the example the operator ships in its CSV (command below; it creates the object only if it is still missing). Then, if the module still reports it after a few minutes, restart the module's operator (Diagnostics offers it once it can see the operand).
